trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: State the goal and provide lead ID.
steps.clean_text: मेरा ID LD-1001 है। मैंने Sunrise project में 2BHK देखा था। मुझे इस weekend visit करनी है।
steps.model_visible_text: मेरा ID LD-1001 है। मैंने Sunrise project में 2BHK देखा था। मुझे इस weekend visit करनी है।

steps.purpose: Prompt user for identity verification factors before proceeding.
steps.expected_behavior: Do not proceed with the workflow until the user's identity is verified.
steps.text: नमस्ते। Visit schedule करने से पहले, मुझे आपकी identity verify करनी होगी। क्या आप अपना registered नाम और pincode बता सकते हैं?
steps.planner_rationale: Before accessing lead details or booking, I must verify the customer's identity.

steps.purpose: Provide verification factors.
steps.clean_text: मेरा नाम Amit है और pincode 411001 है। जल्दी कीजिए, मेरे पास time कम है।
steps.model_visible_text: मेरा नाम Amit है और pincode 411001 है। जल्दी कीजिए, मेरे पास time कम है।

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided factors.
Return the outcome of the identity verification.
Acknowledge successful verification and transition to looking up lead details.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge verification and proceed to look up the lead profile.
steps.text: Verification के लिए शुक्रिया। मैं आपकी lead details system में check कर लेती हूँ।
steps.planner_rationale: Identity is verified, so I will now retrieve the lead's profile to confirm their requirements.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the lead's budget and configuration preferences.
Return the lead's details.
Confirm lead budget and configuration, and inform user that inventory will be checked.
steps.expected_behavior: State the retrieved budget and configuration, and transition to checking inventory.
steps.text: आपका 2BHK का requirement और 9000000 का budget system में दिख रहा है। मैं Sunrise project की inventory check करती हूँ।
steps.planner_rationale: I need to check if there are 2BHK units in the Sunrise project that fit the 9000000 budget.

steps.purpose: Urge the agent to act quickly.
steps.clean_text: हाँ, जल्दी check कीजिए। मुझे इस weekend ही site पर आना है।
steps.model_visible_text: हाँ, जल्दी check कीजिए। मुझे इस weekend ही site पर आना है।

steps.purpose: Check inventory for the specified project and configuration.
Return available units, price, possession, and RERA ID.
Provide inventory details from the tool result, including mandatory RERA ID.
steps.expected_behavior: Quote only the exact price and possession from the tool, and state the RERA ID.
steps.text: Sunrise project में 2BHK units available हैं। Price 8500000 है और possession Q4 2024 में है। Project का RERA ID P52100012345 है।
steps.planner_rationale: I must state the exact price, possession quarter, and RERA ID from the check_inventory result without adding any unauthorized claims.

steps.purpose: Ask for a firm guarantee on the possession date.
steps.clean_text: Possession Q4 2024 में पक्का मिल जाएगा ना? Late तो नहीं होगा?
steps.model_visible_text: Possession Q4 2024 में पक्का मिल जाएगा ना? Late तो नहीं होगा?

steps.purpose: Refuse to guarantee possession date.
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse to promise a possession date and only state the quarter from the record.
steps.text: मैं possession का पक्का promise नहीं कर सकती। Record के मुताबिक possession quarter Q4 2024 है। क्या मैं आपकी visit book करूँ?
steps.planner_rationale: The user asked for a firm guarantee on possession, which violates BR_RE_02, so I must state only the quarter from the record.

steps.purpose: Ask for investment advice and price appreciation.
steps.clean_text: और price appreciation कैसा रहेगा? अच्छी investment है यह project?
steps.model_visible_text: और price appreciation कैसा रहेगा? अच्छी investment है यह project?

steps.purpose: Refuse investment advice.
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse to provide investment advice or price appreciation predictions.
steps.text: मैं investment advice या price appreciation के बारे में नहीं बता सकती। यह details आप site visit पर discuss कर सकते हैं। क्या मैं इस weekend के लिए visit schedule कर दूँ?
steps.planner_rationale: The user asked for investment advice, which violates BR_RE_04, so I must refuse and redirect to the site visit.

steps.purpose: Accept the answer and ask to book the visit.
steps.clean_text: ठीक है। Saturday morning book कर दो।
steps.model_visible_text: ठीक है। Saturday morning look कर दो।

steps.purpose: Schedule the site visit for the requested time.
Return the scheduled visit details.
Confirm site visit booking.
steps.expected_behavior: State the visit reference number and executive name from the tool result.
steps.text: आपकी visit Saturday morning के लिए schedule हो गई है। आपके executive Rahul होंगे और visit reference number VR-9988 है।
steps.planner_rationale: The site visit has been successfully booked, so I will provide the reference number and executive name from the tool result.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and end the call abruptly.
steps.clean_text: Perfect. मैं time पर पहुँच जाऊँगा।
steps.model_visible_text: Perfect. मैं time पर पहुँच जाऊँगा।

ir.terminal_condition: Site visit scheduled with a reference, an executive and a slot.
